params.text:
## Issue Description

When trying to connect to ChatGPT, I'm getting a "connection refused" error. This prevents access to the ChatGPT service.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Try to access ChatGPT
2. Receive connection refused error

## Expected Behavior
Should be able to connect to ChatGPT successfully

## Actual Behavior
Connection refused error

## Environment
- ChatGPT plugin/service
- Connection issue

## Additional Information
This appears to be a network/connection issue that needs investigation.
